data.description:
# Summary

The audit skill (`skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py`) references a `.ralph.json` / `ralph.config.json` config system that no longer exists in this repository. Ralph is not present anywhere on disk (no `skill/ralph` directory, no config files, no project references). These references are dead code and stale documentation.

## Dead code in `audit_runner.py`

- `ASSET_CONFIG_PATH` — points to `skill/ralph/assets/.ralph.json` (missing).
- `RALPH_CONFIG_FILES` — references `.ralph.json` and `ralph.config.json` (neither exists).
- `_load_asset_config()` — loads from missing asset path (fails open to `{}`).
- `_load_config()` — merges asset defaults with CWD config files.
- `_deep_merge()` — helper for `_load_config()`.
- `_extract_phase_model_config()` — extracts per-phase model config from loaded JSON.
- `_resolve_model_for_phase()` — resolves model from config with multi-source resolution.
- `_resolve_phase1_model()` — resolves Phase 1 model (fast/cheap) vs Phase 2 (full).
- `_resolve_phase_model_value()` — resolves a model string from nested config.
- `_coerce_model_str()` — coerces model string.
- `_model_source()` — resolves model source (local/remote).
- CLI flags `--model` and `--phase1-model` — allow overriding the model via config file resolution.
- Docstrings and help text referencing `.ralph.json` / `ralph.config.json`.

## Stale documentation

- `skill/audit/SKILL.md` — lines 221, 232 reference `.ralph.json`/`ralph.config.json` for config keys.
- `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — line 592 references `.ralph.json`/`ralph.config.json` for config keys.

## Test files affected

- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_phase1_model.py` (413 lines) — tests `_extract_phase_model_config`, `_resolve_model_for_phase`, `_resolve_phase1_model`. Entire file is dead tests.
- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_phase2_benchmark.py` — calls `_resolve_model_for_phase()` and `_load_config()`.
- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_core.py` — many tests mock `_load_config` / `_resolve_model_for_phase`.

## Note on unrelated `_load_config`

`machine-hygiene/scripts/metrics.py` and `refactor/scripts/refactor.py` have their own `_load_config` functions — these are unrelated and should be left alone.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Remove from `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py`: `ASSET_CONFIG_PATH`, `RALPH_CONFIG_FILES`, `_load_asset_config()`, `_load_config()`, `_deep_merge()`, `_extract_phase_model_config()`, `_resolve_model_for_phase()`, `_resolve_phase1_model()`, `_resolve_phase_model_value()`, `_coerce_model_str()`, `_model_source()`, and the `--model`/`--phase1-model` CLI flags. Model resolution should fall back directly to `DEFAULT_MODEL`.
2. Remove `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_phase1_model.py` entirely (413 lines of dead tests).
3. Update `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_phase2_benchmark.py` to not call removed functions.
4. Update `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_core.py` to remove mocks of `_load_config` / `_resolve_model_for_phase`.
5. Remove references to `.ralph.json` / `ralph.config.json` from `skill/audit/SKILL.md`.
6. Remove references to `.ralph.json` / `ralph.config.json` from `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md`.
7. Verify no references to `ralph` (or `.ralph.json` / `ralph.config.json`) remain in code or docs (grep across repo).
8. All tests pass.
data.title: Remove stale references to missing .ralph.json and ralph config system
